note_zh: 调用方交给 `TaskQueue` 一个函数和参数。`Task` 把它们保存到稍后执行，工作线程管理到期时间、重试和完成计数。
note_en: A caller supplies a function and its arguments. Task captures the invocation for later, while TaskQueue manages due times, retries and completion.

blocks.summary_zh: 一次调用如何跨线程保存

lines.zh: 队列、时钟和同步原语来自标准库，所有任务都留在当前进程。
lines.en: The standard library provides the queue, clock and synchronization. All jobs stay in this process.

lines.zh: 保存函数、两类参数及重试预算。每个任务单独创建关键字参数字典，两个任务不会共享默认字典。
lines.en: Capture the callable, arguments and retry budget. Each task gets its own default keyword dictionary.

blocks.summary_zh: 在接收任务前启动工作线程
blocks.summary_en: Start the consumers before accepting jobs

lines.zh: 后台线程可以重复执行同一函数，提交有副作用的操作时需要考虑重复执行。
lines.en: A failed callable may run again, which matters for a job that already performed a side effect.

lines.zh: 优先队列保存待领任务；序号和锁解决同一到期时间的排序，事件通知所有线程退出。
lines.en: The priority queue holds pending work. The lock and counter break deadline ties, and one event signals shutdown.

lines.zh: 每个线程进入同一个取件循环。保存线程句柄以便关闭时等待它退出。
lines.en: Each thread enters the same consumer loop. Its handle is kept so shutdown can wait for it.

blocks.summary_zh: 把相对延迟转成可排序的截止时间
blocks.summary_en: Convert a delay into a sortable deadline

lines.zh: 调用立即返回，函数稍后才在工作线程上执行。
lines.en: Submission returns before the worker executes the function.

lines.zh: 在锁内领取唯一序号；多个提交者不会拿到同一个平局排序键。
lines.en: Claim a unique tie-breaker while holding the lock so concurrent submitters cannot reuse it.

lines.zh: 以单调时钟计算最早运行时刻。队列先比时间，再比序号，最后一个字段才是任务。
lines.en: Compute a due time on the monotonic clock. Entries sort by time, then sequence, with the job carried as payload.

blocks.summary_zh: 执行一次尝试并结清队列计数
blocks.summary_en: Execute and account for one attempt

lines.zh: 每隔至多 0.2 秒重新检查停止事件，因此空队列上的线程也能退出。
lines.en: A timed dequeue lets an idle worker recheck the stop event every 0.2 seconds.

lines.zh: 取到未来任务的线程等待到期，再用保存的参数调用函数。停止事件也会唤醒等待；此处醒来后仍会调用函数。
lines.en: A worker holds a future job until its wait ends, then restores the arguments. A stop signal can also end this wait and execution still proceeds.

lines.zh: 记录异常，再扣除一次重试预算。延迟随剩余预算减少而增加，上限 30 秒。
lines.en: Log the failure and spend one retry. The delay grows as the remaining budget shrinks and is capped at 30 seconds.

lines.zh: 重试走同一条提交路径，得到新的到期时间。旧尝试无论成功与否都要结清，否则 join 将一直等待。
lines.en: Resubmission creates a fresh deadline. The old attempt must be marked done even on failure or join could wait forever.

blocks.summary_zh: 等待任务与停止线程是两种操作
blocks.summary_en: Waiting for work and stopping workers

lines.zh: 等待队列中每个条目都被标记完成，包括重试时新建的条目。
lines.en: Wait for every enqueued entry, including retries, to be marked done.

lines.zh: 广播停止信号，并给每个线程至多一秒退出；此方法本身不保证队列已排空。
lines.en: Broadcast shutdown and wait up to a second per worker. This call alone does not guarantee the queue has drained.
